title: Never edit files under generated/
content: The user explicitly stated that no edits should be made to files under the `generated/` directory, as the build process overwrites them.

title: Fix migration error by adding default value
content: To resolve the migration error when adding the `owner` column, a default value of an empty string was added to the `owner` column in `db/schema.sql`. This allows the migration to succeed without data loss.

title: Staging database import window rules
content: The staging database has a specific import window: it is blocked on Friday from 02:00 up to but not including 04:00 UTC. All other times are allowed.

title: Check Python version against Dockerfile
content: The `scripts/check_py.py` script compares the current Python version with the one specified in `.ci/Dockerfile`, exiting with a non-zero code if the current version is older.

title: Deploy target region from config file
content: The `scripts/deploy_target.py` script reads the region from `deploy.cfg` and prints it, providing the target region for deployment.
